summary: A worker-placement game where you gather resources to construct grand buildings for the King while deciding whether to play virtuously or dabble in smuggling and sabotage. Other players can throw your workers in jail or steal your resources, which keeps everyone glancing sideways at the shared building sites and the black market.
praised: tight worker-placement puzzle with meaningful choices
virtue/corruption track adds a moral dimension to strategy
good player interaction without full-on chaos
criticised: can feel mean when workers get jailed repeatedly
some rules overhead (raiding, contracts) for newer players
downtime between turns in higher player counts

interaction.kind: worker sabotage and shared building sites
interaction.detail: Players compete for the same worker-placement spots and can pay to jail an opponent's worker or raid their warehouse, so turn order and timing matter a lot. Buildings under construction are a shared board state everyone contributes bricks to, while resources, virtue, and money are tracked on individual player boards.

scoring.how_you_win: Send workers to gather materials and construct buildings for VP while managing a virtue/corruption track; when a building stack is depleted the game ends and the highest total VP wins.
